observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a retail box for a Dobe brand charging dock.
The box indicates compatibility with Xbox Series S/X and Xbox One controllers.
The box mentions 800mAh high capacity batteries and the ability to charge two controllers.
Photo 1 shows the physical charging dock unit placed next to the box.
The dock has two charging bays and a front panel with controller icons.
A barcode label on the box in photo 1 identifies the model as TYX-1817X.
The two battery packs mentioned by the seller are not visible in either photo.
Photos contain 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'ACELYNKS' watermarks.

claims.claim: Two batteries and a charging dock
claims.evidence: The dock is visible in photo 1, but the two battery packs are not shown outside the box or dock.
Battery performance cannot be verified through photos.
This is a logistics arrangement that cannot be confirmed via product photos.

risks.risk: Batteries may be missing from the package.
risks.proof: A photo showing the two separate battery packs next to the dock.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the charging dock only, without batteries.

risks.risk: The charging dock or batteries may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the dock plugged into power with batteries inserted and the LED indicators active.

proof_requests: Photo of the two 800mAh battery packs included in the sale.
Video of the dock powered on and charging a controller or battery pack to confirm the LEDs work.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model. It is priced at the worst case of a non-functional dock without batteries until the missing components and functionality are proven.
